introHtml: Half zip products combine the easy-on functionality of a pullover with the adjustable ventilation of a zip-up, making them a favorite for corporate teams, outdoor events, and casual office wear. Whether you choose a microfleece quarter-zip for the safety crew or a performance half-zip polo for a sales meeting, this style offers a polished yet comfortable look. Decorate with your logo using embroidery or screen printing for a professional finish that stands out.
